# Verify Basic

Run change-driven checks, distinguish new failures from baseline debt, and preserve evidence for each acceptance criterion.

Use `.pactile/framework/reuse-first-guide.md` to review choice, evidence and maintenance cost. Check integration behavior; dependency or search counts are not quality proof. Justified self-build and disclosed research limits can be valid. Do not repeat unchanged research without a concrete reason.
